name: Aave V3 wstETH CAPO snapshot ratio/timestamp misalignment
summary: WstETHPriceCapAdapter caps the wstETH/stETH ratio at snapshotRatio plus a growth allowance accrued since snapshotTimestamp. A Chaos Labs risk-oracle update through AaveCapoAgent raised snapshotRatio only to the rate-limited 1.1919 while moving snapshotTimestamp to a 7-day-old point meant for 1.2282, so the cap fell to about 1.1939 against a live ratio of 1.2288. The 2.85% underpricing of wstETH collateral on Aave Core and Prime made 36 healthy E-Mode positions liquidatable, and liquidators seized 10,938.59 wstETH.

loss.notes: Borrower net loss: collateral removed (liquidatedCollateralAmount plus protocol fee) valued at the market wstETH price minus debt repaid. 10949.42795971905436333 wstETH x $2532.3941577119963 = $27,728,267.40, less 12943.591932140673786512 WETH x $2064.601277371386, 0.003485279480993781 cbETH x $2321.4657190935527 and 0.000855546946009702 osETH x $2198.374477556695 = $26,723,366.41; net $1,004,900.99 (486.73 ETH). Valuing wstETH at its 1.2288 redemption ratio instead gives about 512 ETH, the post-mortem's figure. BuilderNet refunds, fee recapture and DAO compensation do not reduce incident-time loss.

ageReset.description: CapParametersUpdated set snapshotRatio 1157209899495068171 -> 1191926196478762900 and snapshotTimestamp 1708004591 -> 1772535647; latestAnswer() fell from 2534.75871245 to 2462.76569349 USD as isCapped() turned true.

limitations: AaveCapoAgent 0xcc18be380838956aad41fd22466085ed66aabb46 range-checks snapshotRatio and maxYearlyRatioGrowthPercent but not snapshotTimestamp against the constrained ratio; the liquidations never executed it, so it is described, not targeted.

sources.note: Anchor, root cause and age. AaveOracle getSourceOfAsset(wstETH) on Core 0x54586be62e3c3580375ae3723c145253060ca0c2 and Prime 0xe3c061981870c0c7b1f3c4f4bb36b95f1f260be6 both return adapter 0xe1d97bf61901b075e9626c8a2340a7de385861ef. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-2 (block 24626860, index 0): Chainlink KeeperRegistry 0x6593c7de001fc8542bb1703532ee1e5aa0d458fd -> 0xd298355a03537af04dc2004b19811a30b698f16b -> ChainlinkAgentHub 0x5cfc96c396325724d49dff95da103feddbf48e05 -> AgentHub proxy 0x95e3015c67ef62b866cc28ca5a9ab5017a55e336 -> AaveCapoAgent 0xcc18be380838956aad41fd22466085ed66aabb46 -> adapter setCapParameters (0xc1b8c2e0), emitting CapParametersUpdated at log 1. Adapter views at blocks 24626859/24626860: getSnapshotRatio 1157209899495068171/1191926196478762900, getSnapshotTimestamp 1708004591/1772535647, getRatio 1228848994065905999 at both, isCapped false/true, latestAnswer as recorded. Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, WstETHPriceCapAdapter): latestAnswer() returns base price x min(getRatio(), _getMaxRatio()), and _setCapParameters only requires the new timestamp to exceed the stored one. The corrective update 0xb883ad2f1101df8d48f014ba308550f3251c2e0a401e7fc9cf09f9c2a158259d (block 24628089) set 1228282498700325540/1772535659 and isCapped false. LiquidationCall logs with collateral wstETH on Pool 0x87870bca3f3fd6335c3f4ce8392d69350b4fa4e2 (Core) and 0x4e033931ad43597d96d6bcc25c280717730b58b1 (Prime), blocks 24620000..24640000: 49 events in 41 transactions (source-4), all in blocks 24626860..24626867; source-1 at index 1 immediately after the reset is the first. getUserAccountData at block 24626859 gives every liquidated user a health factor between 1.0016 and 1.0287, so each liquidation required the reset. Age: eth_getCode is empty at block 22219917 and keccak256 of the runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 22219918 and 24626859; source-3 creates the adapter through factory 0x914d7fec6aac8cd542e72bca78b30650d45643d7 and emits its initial CapParametersUpdated. CapParametersUpdated logs from the adapter in blocks 22219918..24626859 are only that initial one, so source-2 is the latest pre-exploit reset and the code age is zero. Loss: for each event, the collateral aToken (Core 0x0b925ed163218f6662a35e0f0371ac234f9e9371, Prime 0xc035a7cf15375ce2706766804551791ad035e0c2) BalanceTransfer from the user to treasury 0x464c71f6c2f760dda6093dcb91c24c39e5d6e18c, value x index / 1e27, is the protocol fee.
